<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C7H11O2 (C=7, H=11, N=0, X=0), the calculation gives DBE = (2*7 + 2 - 11)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, yielding 3.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
